Let $Z(f)$ (the zero set of $f$ ) be the set of all $p \in X$ at which $f(p)=0$. Prove that $Z(f)$ is closed.", "assumptions": [], "domain": "real_analysis", "explicit_subgoals": [], "candidate_text": "Since \(f:X\to\mathbb R\) is continuous and \(\{0\}\) is closed in \(\mathbb R\), the inverse image \(f^{-1}(\{0\})\) is closed in \(X\). By definition,
\[
Z(f)=\{p\in X:f(p)=0\}=f^{-1}(\{0\}).
\]
Therefore \(Z(f)\) is closed."}
